warmup.description: Prepare for heavy anti-extension and anti-rotation work with dynamic core activation.
movements: Bird dog x 10 per side (pause at full extension)
Lunge with rotation x 6 per side

main_exercises.name: Deadlift (Core Bracing Focus)
main_exercises.load_guidance: Use a heavy load you could lift for 6-7 reps, leaving 1-2 reps in reserve
main_exercises.form_cue: Brace your core before lifting and maintain a neutral spine throughout the movement.

main_exercises.name: Toes-to-Bar (or Hanging Straight Leg Raise)
main_exercises.load_guidance: Bodyweight; scale to knee raises if full range is not controlled
main_exercises.form_cue: Lift legs using core control, avoiding excessive swing or kip.

main_exercises.name: Renegade Row
main_exercises.load_guidance: Moderate-heavy dumbbells that challenge stability without rotating hips
main_exercises.form_cue: Keep hips square to the floor as you row, minimizing torso rotation.

main_exercises.name: Barbell Landmine Rotation
main_exercises.load_guidance: Moderate load that allows powerful but controlled rotation
main_exercises.form_cue: Rotate through the torso and hips together, controlling the deceleration.

main_exercises.name: Ab Wheel Rollout
main_exercises.load_guidance: Use a range that challenges you while maintaining full control and no lower back sag
main_exercises.form_cue: Keep ribs down and brace hard as you extend forward, avoiding arching.

main_exercises.name: Farmer’s Carry (Double Dumbbell)
main_exercises.load_guidance: Heavy load that challenges grip and posture while allowing steady walking
main_exercises.form_cue: Walk with controlled steps, shoulders down, and core fully braced.

cooldown.description: Reduce tension in the trunk and restore mobility after heavy compound and stability work.
movements: Child’s pose with side stretch x 60s

phase_notes.menstrual: This session may feel very demanding—reduce load and volume significantly, especially for deadlifts and carries. Focus on controlled reps and core engagement rather than maximal effort.
phase_notes.follicular: Strong phase to push intensity—progress loads on deadlifts and challenge stability in renegade rows and carries. Prioritize quality bracing under heavier loads.
phase_notes.ovulatory: Peak strength and coordination can support heavier lifts and more explosive rotations. Maintain control in rotational work to avoid overextending range.
phase_notes.early_luteal: Sustain high effort but be mindful of fatigue—keep rest periods adequate and avoid rushing through sets. Focus on consistency rather than pushing maximum loads.
phase_notes.late_luteal: High-intensity bracing and heavy lifts may feel taxing—consider reducing load or volume and emphasizing controlled execution over performance.
